summary: Iteration 16 backend-only validation of complete price removal. All 14 pytest tests passed (100%). Products list, admin product CRUD (create/update/validators), orders create+list, admin PDF 'Bon de commande', and admin CSV export are all price-free and behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1529 lines — consider splitting into routers (products/orders/admin/auth) to stay under the 700-line guideline.

CartItem model silently accepts extra fields (e.g. 'price') without raising; harmless because Pydantic default drops them, but adding `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore')` explicitly would document the intent.

seed count check: on a non-empty DB we can only assert >=15; production seed correctness for an EMPTY DB was not directly re-run (would require dropping products). Migration $unset was verified indirectly by asserting no price* key on any current /api/products response.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed products via /api/admin/products then cleaned them up in the same test class. Created two TEST_ orders on client account; these remain in the DB (order deletion endpoint not available).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All price-related fields (price, price_kg, price_piece, price_kg_ttc, price_piece_ttc, tva_rate, total, total_ttc) are absent from /api/products, /api/admin/products, /api/orders, order items and the CSV header. PDF endpoint returns a real %PDF-1.x file >1KB. Product validators enforce: at least one selling unit; cagette_content_kg requires sell_by_kg; cagette_content_pieces requires sell_by_piece. Frontend not tested (per instructions).
